         // thread block shape for the update kernel\nconstexpr int USR = TILE / UTY;           // 8 output rows per thread\nconstexpr int USC = TILE / UTX;           // 4 output columns per thread\n\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(UTX * UTY, 4)\nfwUpdateKernel(unsigned int* __restrict__ dist, unsigned int* __restrict__ path,\n               const size_t n, const unsigned int* __restrict__ panel,\n               const int tile0, const int ltBegin, const size_t k0, const int kc,\n               const int kb) {\n    const int jb = blockIdx.x;\n    const int lt = ltBegin + blockIdx.y;\n    const int ib = tile0 + lt;\n    if (jb == kb || ib == kb) return;\n    const size_t i0 = (size_t)ib * TILE;\n    const size_t j0 = (size_t)jb * TILE;\n    const int ic = (int)min((size_t)TILE, n - i0);\n    const int jc = (int)min((size_t)TILE, n - j0);\n\n    __shared__ unsigned int C[TILE][TPAD];  // local column panel tile (rows i, cols k)\n    __shared__ unsigned int R[TILE][TPAD];  // pivot row panel tile  (rows k, cols j)\n    const int tx = threadIdx.x, ty = threadIdx.y;\n    const int tid = ty * UTX + tx;\n    const unsigned int* cbase = dist + (size_t)lt * TILE * n + k0;\n    const unsigned int* rbase = panel + j0;\n    unsigned int* obase = dist + (size_t)lt * TILE * n + j0;\n    unsigned int* pbase = path + (size_t)lt * TILE * n + j0;\n\n    for (int e = tid; e < TILE * TILE; e += UTX * UTY) {\n        const int r = e / TILE, c = e % TILE;\n        C[r][c] = (r < ic && c < kc) ? cbase[(size_t)r * n + c] : 0u;\n        R[r][c] = (r < kc && c < jc) ? rbase[(size_t)r * n + c] : 0u;\n    }\n\n    unsigned int best[USR][USC];\n    unsigned int pk[USR][USC];\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int a = 0; a < USR; ++a) {\n        const int r = ty + a * UTY;\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int b = 0; b < USC; ++b) {\n            const int c = tx + b * UTX;\n            best[a][b] = (r < ic && c < jc) ? obase[(size_t)r * n + c] : 0u;\n            pk[a][b] = NO_UPDATE;\n        }\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    for (int k = 0; k < kc; ++k) {\n        unsigned int rk[USC];\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int b = 0; b < USC; ++b) rk[b] = R[k][tx + b * UTX];\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int a = 0; a < USR; ++a) {\n            const unsigned int cik = C[ty + a * UTY][k];\n#pragma unroll\n            for (int b = 0; b < USC; ++b) {\n                const unsigned int v = cik + rk[b];\n                if (v < best[a][b]) {\n                    best[a][b] = v;\n                    pk[a][b] = (unsigned int)(k0 + k);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int a = 0; a < USR; ++a) {\n        const int r = ty + a * UTY;\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int b = 0; b < USC; ++b) {\n            const int c = tx + b * UTX;\n            if (pk[a][b] != NO_UPDATE && r < ic && c < jc) {\n                obase[(size_t)r * n + c] = best[a][b];\n                pbase[(size_t)r * n + c] = pk[a][b];\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n'''\ns=s[:start]+new+s[end:]\ns=s.replace('''            fwUpdateKernel<<<dim3(numTiles, cnt), block, 0, st>>>(d_dist, d_path, n, panel, t0, ltBegin,\n                                                                  k0, kc, kb);''','''            fwUpdateKernel<<<dim3(numTiles, cnt), dim3(UTX, UTY), 0, st>>>(d_dist, d_path, n, panel, t0,\n                                                                           ltBegin, k0, kc, kb);''')\nopen(p,'w').write(s)\nEOF\ncmake --build build 2>&1 | grep -Ei \"error|warning\" -A3; {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5-1","id":"msg_011CgoXuUVSSrzjFYfQM2TvN","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA Floyd-Warshall is done, verified bit-exact against the original, and only the two existing files were changed.\n\n**What the program does now**\n\n- **MPI** partitions the matrix into contiguous row blocks (aligned to 64-row tiles) across ranks, one GPU per rank. GPU choice is NUMA-aware among node-local ranks.\n- **CUDA** runs a blocked Floyd-Warshall. The owner of each 64-pivot block closes the diagonal tile and the pivot row panel on a high-priority stream. Every rank then updates its column panel and performs a register-tiled min-plus update of its remaining tiles. The path matrix is maintained with the same \"strictly smaller\" rule as the original.\n- **Panel exchange** avoids Open MPI's slow cross-socket shared-memory copies. The owner DMAs the closed panel into a page-locked MPI-3 shared-memory window, node-local peers DMA it straight into their GPUs, and only empty tokens and acks go through MPI. Ranks on other nodes receive the panel by MPI point-to-point via a per-node leader. A three-slot ring plus one-block lookahead keeps communication overlapped with compute.\n- **OpenMP** parallelizes host-side matrix initialization and the validation check. The random-number stream itself is replayed sequentially so the input graph is identical to the original for any rank count.\n- **CMake** compiles the single source as CUDA, links MPI, OpenMP, and the CUDA runtime, and targets the native GPU architecture by default. The executable name is unchanged.\n\n**Verification**\n\nHashes from the original program for n = 1, 7, 64, 100, 512, 1000, 2048 match the new program for 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, and 8 ranks, with validation passing and exit code 0. Help, unknown-option, and n = 0 behave as before.\n\n**Performance (this node, 4× RTX 3090)**\n\n| n | original CPU | 1 GPU | 2 GPUs | 4 GPUs |\n|---|---|---|---|---|\n| 2048 | 9376 ms | 11 ms | 9 ms | ~10 ms |\n| 8192 | – | 261 ms | 141 ms | 80 ms |\n| 16384 | – | 1959 ms | 992 ms | 514 ms |\n\n**Things worth knowing**\n\n- The 4-GPU result was initially worse than 2 GPUs. Profiling showed Open MPI non-blocking broadcasts across sockets cost about 2 ms per panel. The shared-memory window transport fixed this. Peer-to-peer GPU copies were not an option since these GeForce cards report no peer access.\n- I tried two kernel variants to go faster on a single GPU: a larger 8×4 register tile and a two-pass argmin. Neither beat the current kernel, which is at the integer-instruction throughput limit. Dropping path tracking entirely would gain about 30% but would remove work the original performs, so I kept it.\n- The multi-node leader path is implemented but could only be exercised in its degenerate single-node form here."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":32,"cache_creation_input_tokens":842,"cache_read_input_tokens":152930,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":842},"output_tokens":806,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global","speed":"standard"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"1d4ef5dd-48f3-4e29-b069-afef46e9cb98","uuid":"65ec1da5-dce7-4439-ab69-026dc2ae8d91","timestamp":"2026-11-07T12:02:44.319Z","request_id":"req_011CgoXuUJ2ZYfUQv1cmgTVC"}
